projects.name: (February 2022-March 2023)
details: • Resolved P3 and P4 support tickets by diagnosing issues, participated with senior engineers to address P1 and P2 tickets ensuring timely resolution according to SLA guidelines.
• Utilized ServiceNow to track and resolve issues, ensuring detailed documentation and timely
closure in line with ITIL standards.
• Worked on change requests, implementing configuration and process updates to support evolving
business requirements.
SAP Knowledge (Functional): Core SAP Module Skills in SAP EWM and basic knowledge of SAP MM
• SAP S4 HANA and EWM integration.
• EWM warehouse organization elements and master data – SCU, storage types, storage
sections, storage bins, activity area, staging area, warehouse door and work centers.
• Configuring Availability Groups & Stock Types.
• Handling Unit management – Packaging specifications. Good knowledge on In-bound cycle
with packing using packaging specification.
• Physical Inventory.
• Familiar with Warehouse order creation rules (WOCR).
• Good knowledge in Wave Management.
• Warehouse process type and related configuration.
• Storage control – hands on POSC, LOSC, and Wave Management etc.
• Internal stock transfers using RF and Ad-hoc movements, stock upload using ISU.
• Able to monitor stock movement, execute stock placement and removal using put away and
picking strategies.
• Aware extending the Master data through CIF from ECC to EWM.
• Good Knowledge on RFUI Persona.
• Aware of Lighthouse application.
